plugins.description: Discover recurring patterns in file paths and metadata and classify them as tags, artists, or albums

plugins.name: FFmpeg Tools

plugins.description: Bulk-convert local tracks to another format and inspect deep container/stream/tag + loudness info, all via your system ffmpeg.

plugins.name: Google
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Lyrics and artwork from Google — scraped song lyrics plus artist, album, and tag images

plugins.name: Library Statistics
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: A dashboard of your library composition, listening patterns, and top charts — built from your local library and play history.

plugins.name: Duplicate Finder
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Find duplicate tracks in your library — the same song downloaded twice or in two folders — and reclaim space by deleting the extra copies. Diacritic-insensitive grouping, with optional duration and file-size matching.

plugins.name: Lyrics Search
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Search the lyrics cached in your library, filter matches by artist, title or album, and jump straight to the track.

plugins.name: Web Search
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Adds a Search submenu to artists, albums, and tracks for looking them up on Google, Last.fm, X, YouTube, Genius, and your own custom providers.

plugins.name: Subsonic Browse
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Search, stream, and download across multiple Subsonic/Navidrome servers live — no indexing. A discovery layer separate from your indexed Library.

plugins.name: TIDAL
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Search, stream, and download from TIDAL

plugins.name: Vinyl Deck
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Presses the play queue onto a record: one groove band per track, sized by its duration and cut from its own waveform, with long queues split across sides like a real LP. Hover the record to magnify the grooves, drag the headshell to cue, and use the cue lever to lift or drop the needle. Comes in two decks — a bare record on black, or a silver direct-drive console with a plinth, an S-shaped arm and a working START/STOP. Pick either from the visualizer button in the Now Playing view.

plugins.name: qBittorrent
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Control a qBittorrent WebUI from inside Viboplr: add magnet links, watch live progress, and start, stop or remove torrents without leaving the app.

plugins.name: Soulseek
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Search and download from the Soulseek network via a slskd daemon: ranked results, whole-album grabs, live transfer progress, and finished files that play and reach your library.

plugins.name: rqbit
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Download music over BitTorrent with no torrent client to set up: paste a magnet link or .torrent URL and rqbit fetches it straight into one of your collections. Each download is a one-shot run — nothing keeps running in the background.

plugins.name: AI Assistant
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: An AI assistant on your own model — Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible service. Ask for music in plain words, fill albums, find better copies, tidy titles and tags, and read what a song is about. Asks before changing anything.

plugins.name: Wikimedia Commons
plugins.author: Viboplr
plugins.description: Freely licensed photos of your artists from Wikimedia Commons: a Photos tab on artist pages, each picture credited to its photographer with its licence. AI assistants can search Commons too, so Now Playing cue sheets use real photos.
